newsitem.title: USA: NJ Transport Fund sees no extra bonding in FY '98.
newsitem.headline: NJ Transport Fund sees no extra bonding in FY '98.

text.p: A New Jersey transportation official confirmed Tuesday that the state has an extra $200 million to spend in fiscal 1998, but the bonus will not mean more bond sales from the Transportation Trust Fund Authority.

David Brown, a spokesman for the Department of Transportation, confirmed in a telephone interview that the fund has $900 million to spend in the fiscal year beginning July 1, instead of the usual $700 million.
Brown said the money results from unexpectedly low debt service payments, but it does not mean the trust fund will issue more debt next year.
